adopted_scope: Original Glyph bounds for notice frame ownership only; preserve published Word coordinates, page layout, text, old article boundaries and Run styles.
general_rule: Bind geometry to the same original Word occurrence through canonical sorting; use complete finite nondegenerate declared source bounds to decide closed-frame ownership. Unknown/partial metadata and conflicting duplicate occurrence declarations cannot authorize a frame.
legacy_inputs: Words without explicit native geometry and without a vertical writing-mode declaration retain compatibility geometry; vertical metadata without original bounds remains unknown.
fixture_literals: Original PDF page IDs and Word IDs occur only in tests and static source-membership oracles.
invariants: Unknown/partial/nonfinite/inverted geometry abstains instead of falling back to a plausible box.
No individual or page-wide native coordinate substitution in layout reconstruction.
No geometry-view substitution in financial reordering.
Repeated source bbox/raw pairs with conflicting font or native-bound evidence abstain.

metamorphic_checks.default_CI: Synthetic geometry scaling, source reversal and conflicting occurrence cases; inherited actual seven-page font bijection and emission reversal tests.

remaining_legacy: financial_enclosures.rs still contains title/company length limits, minimum line counts, point tolerances, and company/procedure vocabulary. This batch neither removes nor certifies those older rules.
